answer_1.quote: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has witnessed rapid progress... We propose VC4VG (Video Captioning for Video Generation), a comprehensive caption optimization framework...

answer_2.quote: Automatic Metrics. We employ several metrics in VBench... assessing models trained with different captioning methods... Quantitative results on VBench and MovieGen-Bench...

answer_3.quote: We adopt the LLM-as-judge paradigm to implement automated evaluation, leveraging GPT-4o for extracting target information from captions and determining whether predefined scoring criteria are adequately addressed.

answer_4.quote: Three domain experts perform blind assessments comparing LLaVA-Video-Gen against its closest-performing counterparts... through side-by-side evaluation using GSB (Good, Same, Bad) scoring criteria across five reconstruction dimensions.
answer_4.guideline: Side-by-side video comparison with GSB ratings across dimensions
